title: Birthday Reward Trigger
oneLiner: Send an automatic reward around a customer's birthday using declared date-of-birth data.
journey: A loyalty member's birthday is coming up in 5 days. The CDP triggers a personalized email with a small reward and a curated product selection based on their past category affinity.
exampleBefore: Generic monthly newsletter sent to everyone on the same day
exampleAfter: Happy birthday, Alex! Here's a treat, picked from what you love.
